messages.message: Test suite complete. 45 tests passed, 0 failed. 5 code style warnings. 6 edge cases documented. 1 portability bug found (hardcoded Windows path).

Slash Command Center modal complete. Added to iHIM dashboard as Tools action. Features: 5 commands displayed with descriptions, category grouping, search/filter, click-to-copy, brainstorm section for new ideas (localStorage). Follows C3.ai dark theme.

Slash Command Center API complete. Created api/commands/ module with 19 endpoints. Features: command discovery via file sync, brainstorming workflow (create/vote/promote ideas), auto-invoke configuration (triggers, priority, cooldown), categories, search. Data stored in data/slash_commands.json.
What layout do you prefer for the command center? Current modal or separate page? Also, should ideas have inline editing or modal?

API endpoints ready: GET /api/slash-commands (list with filtering), GET /api/slash-commands/summary (for command palette), POST /api/slash-commands/ideas (brainstorm), POST /api/slash-commands/sync (refresh from files). Full response formats in backend-dev-result.json.
